sections.heading: Brand & attribution
sections.html:
The Attribution clause requires a visible credit. To keep that credit recognisable, present Aethyr consistently wherever it appears.

Required credit

Reproduce this line verbatim in acknowledgements — an About screen, README, credits roll, or documentation:

Aethyr MCP — created by Doug Fessler  https://aethyr.gg

Wordmark

The name is set in Fraunces, uppercase, with wide letter-spacing: Aethyr. Keep it one word with a capital A; do not translate, abbreviate, or rename it.

  • Do keep the credit legible and the link intact.
  • Do place the wordmark on a dark ground for contrast.
  • Don't recolour the wordmark into a gradient, add glow or effects, or re-letterspace it.
  • Don't imply endorsement or partnership beyond the credit itself.

sections.heading: Colour & type
sections.html:
Aethyr is a void ground with four accents. Each accent carries a meaning in the product UI — reuse the coding if you extend it.

  • Cerulean #2fb9ff — primary accent · read
  • Magenta #ff2bd6 — write
  • Violet #9b6bff — batch
  • Ember #ff8a4c — safety & caution
  • Void #0b0c1a — background
  • Ink #e8ecff — text

Typefaces

  • Fraunces — display & wordmark
  • Chakra Petch — labels, UI, small caps
  • Sora — body text
  • JetBrains Mono — code & data
